code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated D-dimer, ferritin, LDH, CRP, and INR, as well as mild renal impairment (creatinine high). These findings suggest a systemic inflammatory response, possible infection or sepsis, and coagulopathy. The constellation may be seen in severe viral infections (e.g., COVID-19) or other critical illnesses. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
